text:
It doesn't sound like you need a lawyer :) If your partner did receive an extension (and it does sound like he would be eligible), it would be for three months from today - see the article Anja posted. And as she said, it is against the protocol to apply while on a tourist visa. Although it's not uncommon for people to start the process this way, it can sometimes lead to delays in the process and maybe greater suspicion from PIBA, as well as the restrictions on leaving/returning that Anja mentioned. 

PIBA won't deport people who have open visa applications - so once you do apply, he is okay. But it is very important to avoid being here illegally so you should try to make sure he has a regular status throughout the waiting period - PIBA should extend his B2 visa on request if you go in.
